name: Kalkar (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Kalkar (three yellow figures around a white shield on red).
history: Municipal flag of Kalkar; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Kalkar arms — three yellow figures around a white shield on red
